title: Cargo insurance policies
definition: The insurance policy covering a shipment, showing the insured value and the insurer. It is requested where the insured value of goods is being compared with the invoiced value, because a policy is priced against the value of the goods and is a more independent figure than an invoice.
evidence_to_cite: the policy, with the insurer, the policy number and the period of cover
the insured value, and the basis on which it was set
the parties to the policy, against the parties to the trade

sources.citation: Insurance documentation as an independent reference for the value of goods, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
